xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The above results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 16th October, 2026. The Statutory Auditor has carried out a Limited Review of the above results.
2. In the earlier years, the Directorate of Enforcement (ED) by way of two separate orders had provisionally attached certain properties, plant and machinery at Dagori and Siltara for Rs. 30758 Lakhs for alleged misuse of coal of Gare Palma IV/4 coal block which got stayed by the PMLA Appellate Tribunal (AT). The Court of Special Judge, New Delhi (CBI Court), vide its order dated 19th March 2024, had discharged the Company, Mr Arvind Jayaswal and Mr Ramesh Jayaswal U/S 3 and 4 of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002 (PMLA), holding that there was no offence of money laundering in the absence of any charge of cheating in securing the allocation of coal block.
The Company had also filed a separate application for release of the attached properties before the CBI Court. The AT by its order dated 28th November 2024 allowed the Company’s appeals and set aside the Provisional Attachment orders.
The ED had challenged the CBI Court order in the Honourable Supreme Court (SC) by filing a Special Leave Petition (SLP). While
hearing the ED’s SLP, the SC, vide its order dated 29th July 2026, disposed of the said SLP and directed the ED to approach the
Hon’ble Delhi High Court (DHC). The SC also requested the DHC to endeavour to decide the matter expeditiously. The SC also
directed the CBI Court to keep the Company’s application for release of the frozen assets pending until the revision petition is
decided by the DHC where the matter was first listed on 19th August,2026. The next date for hearing is 28th October,2026.
3. During the quarter, on exercise of Put option by Maa Usha Urja Private Limited, the Company redeemed 28,08,766 number zero coupon, unlisted, unsecured, redeemable, non-convertible debentures having face value of Rs. 100/- each aggregating to Rs. 2808 Lakhs from its internal accruals.
4. Subsequent to the quarter and half year ended, on 1st October, 2026, the Company has allotted 2,24,39,134 warrants, each carrying a right to subscribe to 1 equity share of the Company, having a face value of Rs. 10/- each at a price of Rs. 89.13/- aggregating to Rs. 20000 Lakhs, which may be exercised and converted in one or more tranches within eighteen months from the date of allotment, to M/s. Vibrant Enterprises, by preferential allotment on a private placement basis consequent to receipt of 25% of the consideration i.e. Rs. 5000 Lakhs during the quarter.
5. The Company jointly holds the equity share capital of “Maa Usha Urja Private Limited”, an associate company without having any beneficiary interest in those shares. Accordingly, the company is not required to prepare the Consolidated Financial Statements.
6. The figures for the corresponding previous period / year have been rearranged/regrouped wherever necessary, to make them comparable.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentsExp:
1. As per Indian Accounting Standard 108 'Operating Segments', the chief operating decision maker of the Company has identified following reportable segments of its business:
a. Steel Segment is engaged in manufacture and sale of Pellets, Pig Iron, Sponge Iron, Billets, Rolled Products and includes its captive power plants at its units located at Siltara, Raipur and Mining activities in the state of Chhattisgarh and Maharashtra.
b. Iron and Steel Castings Segment is engaged in manufacture and sale of Engineering, Construction and Automotive Castings with production facilities at Nagpur in Maharashtra and Anjora in Chhattisgarh.
c. Other Segment comprises of trading of Coal & PVC pipes.
d. Unallocated comprises of income, expenses, assets and liabilities which can not be directly identified to any of the above segments.
2. The Company has operations in India. There is no identified Geographical Segment.
